name: Popover
summary: Anchored floating surface with content or interaction.

props.name: trigger
props.description: One element, and it becomes the trigger — the engine merges the ref and the ARIA into it instead of wrapping it, so your button stays your button.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading inside the panel, rendered as a <strong>.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. This is the overlay that may hold focus and interactive elements; a Tooltip may not.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side. It flips on its own when there is no room, so this is a preference, not a promise.
